comment: Seed to Shelf: the AI impact case film (one grower's season, six cases, each closing on its impact formula). Same fields as vo_script.json. Build with CUT=impact. Line ids use their own prefixes (x n l u k b g z). Lines whose words are on screen carry caption:false (only used by captioned cuts).

lines.text: A seedling that never comes up.
A harvest that misses the order.
A crate at the wrong store.
Impact isn't a promise. It's a formula.
lines.tts: Impact isn't a promise... It's a formula.

lines.text: At Eagerworks, every AI project starts by defining how its impact will be measured.
Here's one grower's season, from seed to shelf.
It starts in the nursery.
Cameras over the moving trays count and size every seedling, and flag weak trays early.
More seedlings survive: less replanting, fewer days with an empty field.
lines.tts: More seedlings survive... less replanting, fewer days with an empty field.

lines.text: The impact: seedlings saved, times the cost of each one.
lines.tts: The impact... seedlings saved, times the cost of each one.

lines.text: In the field, a camera on the tractor measures every lettuce.
The model forecasts the boxes ready each day, and matches them to the orders.
Less product thrown away. Fewer short deliveries.
The impact: boxes not wasted, times their cost, plus shortfalls avoided, times the penalty.
lines.tts: The impact... boxes not wasted, times their cost, plus shortfalls avoided, times the penalty.

lines.text: At harvest, every field needs its size split.
Off-the-shelf models missed onions, so a custom model over the windrower counts each one once, and sorts it by size.
lines.tts: Off-the-shelf models missed onions... so a custom model over the wind rower counts each one once, and sorts it by size.

lines.text: The impact: sampling hours saved, times their cost, plus tonnes in the right size band, times the price difference.
lines.tts: The impact... sampling hours saved, times their cost, plus tonnes in the right size band, times the price difference.

lines.text: In the packhouse, every pumpkin is counted and graded for quality, with no hand counts.
So each one sells in the right class, at the right price.
The impact: hours saved, times cost per hour, plus kilos graded right, times the price difference.
lines.tts: The impact... hours saved, times cost per hour, plus kilos graded right, times the price difference.

lines.text: At dispatch, one crate at the wrong supermarket means a rejection, and a fine.
AI recognizes each crate, checks the order, labels it, and holds back any mismatch.
Fewer rejections, returns and lost product.
The impact: rejections avoided, times the fine, plus the product, plus the freight.
lines.tts: The impact... rejections avoided, times the fine, plus the product, plus the freight.

lines.text: Finally, it all lands in one place.
One data foundation powers a live dashboard, self-building reports, and alerts while there's still time to act.
Ask in plain English, and the answer comes from live data.
The impact: reporting hours saved, times the cost per hour.
lines.tts: The impact... reporting hours saved, times the cost per hour.

lines.text: Six problems. Six formulas. One season.
lines.tts: Six problems... Six formulas... One season.

lines.text: Because AI is only worth building when you can measure what it gives back.
Eagerworks AI Studio.
Let's find your formula.
